title: Should tai have a plugin asset type for Claude Code plugin folders?
description:
Should tai have a `plugin` asset type for Claude Code plugin folders (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `hooks/hooks.json`, skills inside)? Today they install as several file assets with hand-written `dest` paths, which is how the dot-directory `dest` bug surfaced. An asset type would know the folder layout and could map it per target, or skip targets that have no plugin concept.

Raised in GitHub issue #12 (part 1) as worth considering, not as a request.
creator: Alexander Terp
